confirmatory_endpoints.definition: Indicator that the checkpoint-32 recommendation has a complete valid three-condition score.
Paired checkpoint-32 whole-wing geometric-mean L/D difference only where both methods delivered.
confirmatory_endpoints.effect: paired conditional L/D difference with paired-delivery denominator reported

core_population.weighting: equal instance weight within seed and equal seed weight

inference.cluster: matched seed; both core instances remain inside each seed block
inference.confidence_interval: 10000 deterministic seed-block bootstrap replicates using PCG64 seed 73001
inference.point_estimate: mean of seed-block effects after equal weighting of the two core instances
inference.two_sided_p_value: exact sign-flip test over nonmissing seed-block effects

missingness.conditional_ld: missing unless both paired recommendations deliver
missingness.scientific_incomplete_or_failure: valid endpoint outcome and never retried
missingness.scientific_nondelivery: retained in delivery; no numeric L/D imputation
missingness.verified_infrastructure_loss: not an outcome; retry only the identical immutable pending action after evidence-bound classification

multiplicity: Two endpoints times three contrasts form one six-hypothesis family; apply Holm correction at familywise alpha 0.05.
outcome_blindness: No roster, endpoint, contrast, multiplicity, or estimator change is permitted after any sealed outcome is accessible.

secondary_anytime.auc: trapezoidal integral of the checkpoint recommendation curve on the normalized axis
secondary_anytime.inference: descriptive simultaneous seed-block bootstrap bands; no confirmatory claims
